tags.gist: Welcomes the initiative to build a framework, responding only where research-site operations add a perspective.
Calls the two axes sound but wants a supplementary category for non-device AI tools in GCP-regulated research, with regulatory harm as a consequence class.
Wants oversight extended to operator-level staff such as research coordinators, with sponsors showing site personnel have defined competency standards for judging outputs.
Wants monitoring to include audit-trail transparency recording AI recommendations, operator decisions and reasons, since accepted outputs otherwise leave no trace.
Calls the paper a necessary foundation with gaps for research sites in risk assessment, operator oversight and audit trails that will surface as GCP deficiencies.
